Name: 1st Company
Description: CMC company relieved by 5 Coy on Groombridge; its men attacked civilians on sight.

Name: 2nd Company
Description: CMC company.

Name: 3rd Company
Description: CMC company whose rescue team was lost in the Sirent Cing system.

Name: 5th Company
Description: The Colonial Marine company the archive is about.

Facts.V: Stood down into a training rotation
All members transferred and company colours laid up at regimental HQ

Facts.Note: Mexal: 'the Immediate Response Battalion of the CMC - in other words, us'

Name: Alfatek Systems
Description: High-quality military and security hardware.

Name: Amish of Homeworld
Description: Anti-technological Amish Christian sect settled on Homeworld early in the 21st century.

Name: Amish Zealots
Description: Militant Amish who declared a jihad against all outsiders on Homeworld.

Name: The Argaran Corporation
Description: Secretive bio-engineering specialists.

Name: Banordyne Inc
Description: Military equipment and genetics; denies having had a facility on Insulon III.

Name: Black Flaggers
Description: Elite CMC Special Forces squad from 3 Coy, sent to rescue the kidnapped Diplo Team.

Name: Blackwell Power
Description: Power generation and starship systems; built the first starship with Parnell. Rumoured teleportation research.

Facts.V: Built the first starship, the Santa Marie, with Parnell Industries (2065)

Name: Chidanian groups
Description: Groups from the Chidan region of Groombridge who raided Bush War weapons dumps; captured Marines in 2493 and set off a nuclear device.

Facts.V: Chidan province declared independence in the Groombridge Central House

Name: Chronicallers
Description: Earth-based body through which Hengists route evidence of Maker contact.

Name: CIB
Description: Ran an investigation, part of the GEMS inquiry, that pulled in all former members of 5 Coy after Dec 2497.

Name: CMC Area Command
Description: CMC area headquarters; Colonel Nasco commanded it around 2491-92.

Name: CMC Central Command
Description: CMC central headquarters; General Sullivan was based there.

Name: Combat Engineering Department
Description: CMC technical support group proposed by Mexal at Colonel Svjenson's request in early 2495; still referred to in 2602.

Name: CMC Covert Operations
Description: CMC branch whose specialists were escorted to Hal to train the rebels.

Name: CMC High Command
Description: Top level of the CMC; in Feb 2496 it refused UW orders to kill all surviving GEMs as illegal.

Name: CMC Immediate Response Battalion
Description: CMC battalion that Mexal says 5 Coy belonged to in 2494.

Name: CMC IV Field Regiment
Description: CMC field regiment that 5 Coy belonged to.

Name: CMC Provost Marshal's Office
Description: CMC military police office.

Name: CMC Special Investigation Branch
Description: CMC investigators who looked into charges after the Homeworld shuttle rescue.

Name: Celestial News Network
Description: News network; a CNN crew interviewed 5 Coy on Liahn in 2495, and CNN Newsline reported General Sjvenson's death in Oct 2501.

Facts.Role: Press crew; interviewed 5 Coy and the Marie Celeste survivors

Name: CoedArian
Description: Elven world that made contact with the UW; Mexal was the first of its people to serve with UW forces.

Name: Colonial Marine Corps
Description: The UW's military arm, grown out of the space watchdog authority set up after the Groombridge Bush War, enforcing UW edicts and the arms limitation laws.

Name: Colonial Survey
Description: UW survey service whose investigators blamed the Grant's Place colonists; its shuttle from the CSS Lone Star vanished.

Name: Corporate data-tap operation (Sheridan/Frankin)
Description: Unnamed corporation whose data tap intercepted Mexal's letters home from 2493; its staff pass them between Data Centre 32 (Sol) and Corporate HQ on Lumiere.

Name: De Witt Mining Inc
Description: Environmentally destructive miner; co-owner of Sirius after it seceded in 2496.

Facts.V: Sirius (from March 2496, with GARP)

Facts.Role: Hostile; bought Sirius from DeSignieur and began fortifying it against the UW
Rival claimant to the draken ore deposit

Name: DEA
Description: Drugs agency that raided the 5 Coy base on Liahn on a tip-off.

Name: Deep Space Research unit
Description: Took over the Garavaglia II as a deep space survey vessel in March 2499.

Name: Roger DeSignieur's Security Forces
Description: Bodyguard force for DeSignieur, believed trained and led by Farquar.

Name: Douglas clan
Description: Feuding clan of Nyytoda.

Name: The Erasmus Corporation
Description: Industrial chemicals; denies chemical weapons research.

Name: Evolution Party
Description: Political party on Groombridge.

Name: Freemen For Freedom
Description: Hal resistance force made up of freemen.

Name: Future Party
Description: Political party on Groombridge.

Facts.Note: Claims persecution of its members by puritanistic Chidanians

Name: GARP Corporation
Description: Shadowy corporation; co-owner of Sirius after it seceded in 2496.

Facts.V: Sirius (from March 2496, with De Witt Mining)

Facts.Role: Hostile; bought Sirius from DeSignieur and began fortifying it against the UW

Name: Gem-Star Holdings
Description: Scientific and medical equipment and cybernetic implants; major medical supplier to the CMC.

Name: GEMs
Description: Long-lived Genetically Engineered Marines from Project Gemstone (c.2376), passive but prone to berserk rage; imprisoned, written off and dumped on Homeworld.

Name: Grant clan
Description: Largest of the three feuding clans of Nyytoda; claims the land the Marine base stands on.

Name: Groombridge Central House
Description: Chamber of the Groombridge parliament.

Name: Groombridge Democrats
Description: Political party on Groombridge.

Name: Groombridge environmentalists
Description: Locals and environmentalists who violently opposed the nuclear plan.

Name: Groombridge Planetary Government
Description: Awarded a Disaster Relief Medal to all Marines on the April 2495 mission to stabilise Groombridge.

Name: Groombridge Puritan Party
Description: Political party on Groombridge.

Facts.V: Name suggests affiliation

Name: Hadens-Worthy
Description: Owners of the starship Marie Celeste, whose obstruction contributed to the deaths on board in 2495. A "Hainsworthy" luxury liner was destroyed in Jan 2501 (probably the same company).

Facts.Role: Ship owner; obstructed requests for data

Name: 12th Cohort
Description: Hal Armed Forces unit commanded by an Ensign.

Name: 49th Unified
Description: Hal Armed Forces unit on Hal in 2495.

Name: Hal Freedom Army
Description: Hal resistance force, possibly ex-army.

Name: Hal Planetary Defence
Description: Armed forces of Hal: regulars, special forces and reserve/militia legions using naval ranks.

Name: Hal Revolutionary Movement
Description: Resistance movement on Hal with wide popular and military support.

Name: Slave Security
Description: Bounty-hunting slave security units on Hal.

Name: The Hengists
Description: Harmless believers that alien Makers shaped humanity; name taken from Stonehenge.

Facts.Role: Hostile (sabotage crew and hard-line strike team)

Name: Hommilabs
Description: Drug and cybernetic implant manufacturer.

Name: Ickthyn Services
Description: Unknown.

Name: In The Line Of Fire
Description: Gossip magazine for CMC Marines, distributed by the CMC from 2495.

Name: Independance for Clones
Description: Movement campaigning for the rights of clones, founded by Angus McCall.

Name: Intelcorp
Description: Communications; with Network Systems holds a near-monopoly on sat-links.

Name: Interstella!
Description: News publication ("Interstella!") whose reporters included Krystal Spyers and Morgan Blake; covered Sirius, Groombridge, Nasco and 5 Coy from 2491.

Name: Interstellar Communications Group
Description: Media organisation employing Krysal Spyers.

Name: Iowa Power
Description: Power systems and fuels; owners of Golgotha, declared unsafe in 2490 after a chemical plant explosion.

Facts.V: Golgotha
Complained to the UW about CMC presence on Golgotha

Facts.Role: Rival claimant to the draken ore deposit

Name: IRAG
Description: CMC division created in 2492 to provide specialist computing and data retrieval for Marine operations; headed by Joel Turner from May 2492.

Name: Ixtyl
Description: Unknown.

Name: Jefferson Electronic Systems
Description: Military equipment and starship navigation/control; unofficial genetic research into better soldiers.

Name: Juliette Government
Description: Government of the planet Juliette, with a feudal nobility, an old-fashioned Space Navy, ground troops and a Special Police.

Name: Juliette Space Navy
Description: Space navy of Juliette that shadowed the Garavaglia's drones.

Name: Juliette Special Police
Description: Police with authority over everyone else on Juliette; a patrol was wiped out by 5 Coy.

Name: JVC
Description: Corporation; Mr Farquhar was a former executive.

Name: Kasdunni
Description: Region and faction of Groombridge at war with the Chidanian separatists from 2492.

Name: Krugan Militia
Description: Militia of the planet Kruger, based at Villhamstead.

Facts.V: Loaned the CMC a training area on Kruger

Name: League Against Warfare
Description: Pacifist movement founded by Zandra Constella that turned to bombing military and UW sites; membership is a criminal offence.

Name: Li Sung Leisure
Description: Leisure equipment and domes; opened a whole pleasure planet.

Name: Liane Planetary Government
Description: Government of Liahn; renegade SF tried to persuade it to secede from the UW. Awarded the Liane Merit Star for the renegades' removal.

Name: Malenski Transportation Corporation
Description: Transport; rumoured teleportation prototype.

Name: Mercenaries aboard the Marie Celeste
Description: Unnamed hostile mercenaries on board the Marie Celeste.

Name: Medi-Care
Description: Drug manufacturer with a substantial R&D section.

Name: Merton Publishing Inc
Description: Publishers of vid-discs, news-slugs and books.

Name: Military Mercantile
Description: Weapons and armour; major CMC supplier that grew rich in the Colonial War.

Facts.V: Groombridge (head office)

Name: Nas-Corp
Description: Military equipment; suspected of raiding a Banordyne testing lab on Insulon III. Spokesman Mr Colton.

Facts.Note: Suspected raid on Banordyne testing station, Insulon III

Name: Nautilus
Description: Corporation (and undersea vessel with a crew of 50-60) employing deep sea miners on Heurls.

Name: Network Systems
Description: Communications and computer equipment; rumoured brain-computer link research.

Facts.V: Groombridge (head office)

Name: New Worlds Inc
Description: Terraformers campaigning against the rule that worlds must be proven free of sentient life first.

Name: Night Hawks
Description: Paramilitary secret police on Sirius under Nasco, working for Roger DeSignieur; slaughtered the late Baron's staff.

Facts.V: Possible links through Nasco

Name: Nordberg Shipping Corporation
Description: Interplanetary and interstellar transport.

Name: The Nu Phoenicians
Description: Mercenaries from the world Nu Phoenicia, with a strong code of honour and a terrible accent.

Name: Nyytoda Federal Police
Description: Local police who arrested the Smythes.

Name: O'Donnald family
Description: Civilians stranded on X243 who traded salvage for passage off planet.

Name: One True Church
Description: Officially recognised as the main religion.

Name: Palmini Defence Systems Inc
Description: Planetary and orbital defence systems.

Name: Parnell Industries
Description: The most powerful corporation, through its hold on the Jump Synchronicity Enabler; its head held the UW presidency from its inception until 2497. Also electronics and computers.

Facts.Note: Charged with trying to suppress Tyrell's new Jump Drive Controller

Facts.V: Discovered the Jump Synchronicity Enabler (JSE)

Name: Parnell Security Force
Description: Parnell Industries security force (Drive Wars scenario notes).

Name: Plougher clan
Description: Feuding clan of Nyytoda.

Name: Puritans
Description: Xenophobic movement seeking the destruction of mutated or non-pure humans such as the Urthankoi; under CMC investigation.

Facts.Note: Nas-Corp is a common target of Puritan protests

Facts.V: Rumoured ("Purity") to want the Corps kept strictly human

Name: The Restyk Corporation
Description: Clone growth and Mem-Rec memory recording for paying customers.

Facts.Role: Hostile (security teams); partner in Project Gemstone

Name: Personal Guard of Senator Deter Francis
Description: The Senator's personal army and bodyguards.

Name: Sigma Mining Corporation
Description: Planetary and asteroid mining, plus salvage.

Name: Sirian Defence forces
Description: Armed forces of Sirius.

Name: Sirius local insurgents
Description: Rebel cells on Sirius coordinated by "Viper".

Name: Sjvenson Fire and Rescue
Description: Sjvenson family firm based on Sol3; General J. Sjvenson became its CEO in 2500.

Facts.V: Sol3 (testing base on Neptune)

Name: Slaves For Freedom
Description: Hal resistance force made up of former slaves.

Name: Solrebrians
Description: Alien civilisation; its diplomats left Sol3 in Jan 2496, six months after full UW membership.

Facts.V: Broke diplomatic ties and left Sol3

Name: Space Accident Investigation Board
Description: Body to which the Marie Celeste incident was to be referred.

Name: Stoppers
Description: Group paid by corporate interests to wreck the Groombridge plan.

Name: Sugar Mice
Description: Mercenary unit from Lumiere; Avo Stetto (AWOL from 2 Coy CMC) took command in 2487. Joel Turner was its computer specialist ("ICEMan") until 2490.

Name: Svensonn Automation Inc
Description: Robotics and droids; rumoured combat-droid work.

Name: Tadson & Romburg Construction
Description: Builders of planetary infrastructure, starports and stations.

Name: Tedmann Controls Inc
Description: Unknown.

Name: The Brotherhood
Description: Terrorist group that claims to fight UW repression and treats the CMC as its military face; hireable and unpredictable.

Facts.V: Took the CMC to the UW courts over projectile weapons
Involvement with the Chidanians on Groombridge

Name: Tyrell Corporation
Description: Small corporation that, in the Drive Wars scenario notes, develops a superior Jump Drive Controller that Parnell tries to suppress.

Name: United Europe
Description: Earth power bloc; employer of Henri Le Geere; claimed the Groombridge system in 2075 and fought the Groombridge Bush War.

Facts.Note: First recorded space combat, Groombridge system, 2075

Name: United Worlds
Description: Federation of worlds formed after Earth lost the Colonial War; a council with a seat per world, in practice dominated by the corporations.

Name: UW Colonial Intelligence Agency
Description: UW intelligence agency whose operatives had infiltrated Hal's Slave Security for over two years.

Name: UW Colonial Navy
Description: UW naval service; Surgeon Commander Mimiannapandawawa served in it.

Name: UW Colonisation Team, Grant's Place
Description: UW-funded colony on Grant's World being prepared for Groombridge survivors.

Name: UW Combat Medical Team
Description: UW medical unit named in the Vortex cover story.

Name: UW Courts
Description: UW judiciary; issued the injunction 5 Coy enforced on Heurls.

Name: UW Diplo Team (Groombridge)
Description: UW diplomatic team sent to Chidan on Groombridge in 2492; kidnapped in July 2492.

Name: UW Diplomatic Service
Description: Awarded the Medal of Merit to Col A Gillham and Sgt Ruby Axe.

Name: UW Military Intelligence
Description: UW military intelligence; had operatives undercover with the renegade SF on Liahn.

Name: UW Rapid Reaction Battalion
Description: Battalion created by Col A Gillham; its success led the UW to disband Special Forces in its favour. Disbanded Dec 2497.

Facts.V: Disbanded; members redeployed to other CMC units

Name: UW Special Forces
Description: UW special forces structure disbanded in favour of the RRB (c.2495); renegade units mounted the operation on Liahn. Reformed under direct control of the UW President in Nov 2497.

Facts.V: Disbanded in favour of the RRB
Reformed under the direct control of the UW President

Facts.Role: Opposing force in a live-fire training exercise

Facts.V: Renegade units funded by mining and marketing Bodonite ore
Project Gemstone partners

Name: Special Forces Bravo Company
Description: Former UW Special Forces company that was the main hostile force on Liahn.

Name: UW Survey
Description: UW survey service; joint partner in Pegasus and sponsor of the 2492 X244 survey team.

Name: Investigative/watch-dog authority
Description: Body formed after the Groombridge Bush War (2125) to police space; later given a military arm and renamed the Colonial Marine Corps.

Facts.V: Formed after the Groombridge Bush War (from 2125)

Name: UWBI
Description: UW investigative body that returned Baron Lukel of Sirius to power in 2492, through 5 Coy.

Name: Valen Pharmaceuticals Inc
Description: Drugs, with probably the largest medical R&D department.

Name: WWW News
Description: News agency on Homeworld ahead of the CMC.

Name: Xeno Corps Security
Description: Rumoured identity of mercenaries who seized a main charge on Groombridge.
